title: AI-Lab proposed qualification assessment r2 — schema only
$comment: Proposal, not runtime registration or admission. All references are local. Use a draft-2020-12 validator with format assertion. Reject duplicate JSON keys and nonfinite numbers before schema validation. Validate retained-byte digests, schema IDs, cross-reference equalities, temporal ordering, pinned context and semantic decisions per DETERMINISTIC-RULES.md; schema validity alone is no identity, coverage, independence, authority or origin proof.

Sha256.description: SHA-256 of complete retained bytes; not a schema record ID or a Git SHA-1.

Timestamp.description: Explicit offset, uppercase T/Z, real calendar date and time, zero to six fractional digits. Naive timestamps and leap-second spellings are unsupported. Duplicate JSON keys and nonfinite numeric tokens are rejected before schema checks. Semantic rules compare instants and validate intervals, not lexicographic strings.

ArtifactRef.description: The pinned store supplies exact bytes. Every digest and any schema ID must be independently recomputed. A reference is not an existence, kind or truth finding.

Interval.description: Inclusive validity interval. Non-null valid_until before valid_from is INVALID_INTERVAL. Revocation is effective at event >= revoked_at. No caller-established flag.

Reason.description: Safe bounded diagnostic only. Stage order: 0 parsing, 1 integrity, 2 inventory, 3 binding/time, 4 aggregation, 5 witness, 6 identity, 7 C3/C10, 8 adapter/domain. Canonical order is stage, ReasonCode declaration order, side, sorted references; preserve all reasons.

ModelSourceRef.description: Refers to complete bytes; linkage, capture_success, target kind, schema ID, release scope and availability are recomputed from those bytes. Wrong-kind/dangling targets remain representable for typed refusal.

SourceInventory.description: Immutable inventory pinned by the consumer context anchor. Enumerate every tracked file recursively below all five fixed roots; no caller path glob, subset, complete flag or source-priority rule. Synthetic anchors name the fixed fictional store, not a real Git observation.

ProductionProfiles.description: All production positive profiles are EMPTY in r2. These arrays cannot activate profiles.

ContextPolicy.description: Pinned by the consumer, not configurable in Query. The default is 30 days; defaults do not insert missing fields. Other nonnegative values require a separately pinned context. Tool/human profiles use their own interval/revocation rules.

DirectionalPath.description: Declared directional path requiring recomputation against retained evidence. Edge count must equal node count minus one. A spawned or common-input relation alone cannot satisfy an edge.

C3Context.description: Pinned obligations and references; no complete/independent/established flag. Only a unique matching SYN-C3-CONFLICT-1 context/edge/assessment row can establish a synthetic direct/equivalent violation. Unsupported or production directional evidence stays unresolved. No positive C3 output exists.

C10Context.description: Exact run/property linkage is checked against retained bytes; producer remains ModelIdentity. No receiving-decision consequence or attempted reliance is bound, and no live review admissibility rule is enabled: C10 always unresolved in r2. Unknown ancestry is not shared ancestry or independent lineage.

EvidenceContext.description: Pinned outside caller authority by the selected consumer entry point. The consumer rejects any other context digest/cutoff/inventory and recomputes selected sources and omissions. Production has no activated live context anchor in r2.

Query.description: Caller domain is checked for mismatch against the entry point, never used to select privilege. Query cannot choose freshness, source roots, profiles, knowledge cutoff, established bindings or coverage.

CorroborationWitness.description: Candidate evidence shape, never a trusted assertion of success. Synthetic profile checks the pinned fixture proof table and all exact bindings. No production profile is enabled; a production witness-shaped object cannot clear Q_identity.

HumanPrincipalRow.description: SYN-HUMAN-1 maps exactly one immutable fictional person to one principal. Roles, accounts, keys and delegation do not create persons.

SyntheticFixtureBindings.description: Entire fixture corpus ID/digest is fixed outside Query by evaluate_synthetic_r2. Identity profiles exercise necessary identity conditions only. The separately named SYN-C3-CONFLICT-1 constructor supplies fictional negative directional premises only; neither it nor any identity profile can establish production binding, positive ancestry coverage, independent qualification or authority.

CatalogAssertion.description: Read-only decoded legacy shape. For resolves_to the semantic stage requires a MID string and extant valid target bytes. Scope=null is supported; non-null scope is retained but unsupported. Invalid intervals are errors; scalar targets and unknown scopes never silently resolve.

CatalogCapture.description: capture_success=false is structurally valid but non-qualifying. Exact snapshot linkage and source-class restrictions are semantic checks; content_digest hashes payload, not this complete capture record.

CatalogMID.description: Unknown release remains structurally valid and may support a scoped catalog assertion only; it cannot clear the identity gate. Compute schema ID and full byte digest separately.

ConstraintFinding.description: No conditions_satisfied/independent/authorized value is available for C3/C10 in either r2 domain.

CoverageFinding.description: Derived finding over the anchored bounded inventory only, never global completeness. It is not a caller input or a qualification flag.

AssessmentResult.description: Output domain is derived from the entry point. Only clean governed aggregation may populate R_identity. Production Q_identity is withheld and production C3 unresolved. Synthetic C3 can only be violated under SYN-C3-CONFLICT-1 or unresolved; C10 is unresolved in both domains. Q_C3_C10 mirrors C3; no positive combined result exists. Invalid envelopes remain unresolved/withheld. No lineage or authority status is writable.

DeclaredUnavailableSource.description: Pinned declaration of a known unavailable source, including unknown bytes/digest/scope. Null digest never acts as an affirmative ArtifactRef; unknown endpoint/name remains potentially relevant until applicability is established.

AvailabilityEvidence.description: Retained availability claim, not an established/complete flag. Only an exact harness-pinned synthetic row can establish fictional availability in r2; production availability registry is empty. Exact subject byte/digest coverage, observation and capture lower bounds, and mode-specific event/knowledge upper bound are recomputed. Timestamp declarations alone are insufficient; catalog-declared supplied_relation may survive while R_identity remains unresolved.

SyntheticDirectedEdge.description: Fictional directional premise only when its complete bytes and every field match an edge row in the harness-pinned SYN-C3-CONFLICT-1 fixture. A hash, this shape, or an unattested edge is not real directional evidence; no spawned-only edge kind exists.

SyntheticDirectedEdgeRow.description: edge_ref must identify the exact serialized edge bytes; edge is their decoded value. Both must equal the immutable fixture row, including source/target/class/observation.

SyntheticAncestorAssessmentRow.description: The retained synthetic AssessmentResult and Query bind this exact ancestor/adjudicator pair through an earlier, separately byte-bound acyclic context/fixture provenance DAG. Earlier context/policy/result labels are provenance only. Validate both Subjects against current pinned invocation bytes, then recompute identity-only R_identity internally using CURRENT consumer inventory/profiles/cutoff. Do not call the old public Query adapter, trust the old R label, or recurse into C3/C10. Require equivalent and a verified ancestor-to-claim path. Reject dependency cycles and references back to the current fixture/context before dereference; the earlier identity-only fixture can have empty C3 rows.

SyntheticC3ConflictContextRow.description: Full C3Context must equal one unique harness-pinned context row. Check all edge bytes, observation bytes, ordered endpoints and edge count. A supported adjudicator-to-claim path or supported equivalent-ancestor-to-claim path gives only synthetic C3=violated. Missing unrelated coverage cannot erase a proved conflict; unknown/unsupported direction remains unresolved.

SyntheticC3ConflictFixture.description: Negative-conflict fixture constructor, not an ancestry coverage or positive qualification profile. Query cannot provide/replace the fixture anchor. No production use or positive C3/C10 result exists.
